zh.principle: **算法**：FEAL 分组密码（Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm）。HAC 第 7.5 节一开头就点出对象并说明它出名在什么地方：「The Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm (FEAL) is a family of algorithms which has played a critical role in the development and refinement of various advanced cryptanalytic techniques, including linear and differential cryptanalysis.」（快速数据加密算法 FEAL 是一族算法，在各种高级密码分析技术的发展与打磨中起过关键作用，其中包括线性分析与差分分析）。参数就在同一行给出：「FEAL-N maps 64-bit plaintext to 64-bit ciphertext blocks under a 64-bit secret key.」（FEAL-N 在 64 位保密密钥下把 64 位明文映射为 64 位密文块）；结构表述为 「It is an N -round Feistel cipher similar to DES (cf.Equations (7.4), (7.5)), but with a far simpler f -function, and augmented by initial and final stages which XOR the two data halves as well as XOR subkeys directly onto the data halves.」（它是 N 轮的 Feistel 密码，与 DES 相像，但 f 函数远为简单，并增设首末两级，既对两个数据半区做异或，也把子密钥直接异或到数据半区上）——其中 N -round 与 f -function 里多余的空格是本抽取件对斜体记号的排印方式，此处照留。该节在第 1384 行具体写出 8 轮成员（「Algorithm 7.94 specifies FEAL-8.」（算法 7.94 给出 FEAL-8）），其轮函数用两个字节导向的 S 盒 S0、S1，各用两次。承重的一句在第 1502 行：「As the operations of 2-bit rotation and XOR are both linear, the only nonlinear elementary operation in FEAL is addition mod 256.」（由于 2 位循环与异或都是线性的，FEAL 中唯一的非线性初等运算是模 256 加法），即非线性只来自模 256 加法；同一行给出的 f 函数输入宽度是 32 与 16 的乘积，其乘号在本抽取件中字形已损，故只作转述。解密不需要第二套算法：「Decryption may be achieved using Algorithm 7.94 with the same key K and ciphertext C = (R8, L8) as the plaintext input M , but with the key schedule reversed.」（解密可用算法 7.94，取同一密钥 K、把密文 C = (R8, L8) 当作明文输入 M，但密钥编排反序进行），并且 「This is directly analogous to decryption for DES (Note 7.84).」（这与 DES 的解密直接类似）（hac-ch7-cast.txt:1513）。族记号在同节定义：第 1520 行说 「FEAL with 64-bit key can be generalized to N -rounds, N even.」（带 64 位密钥的 FEAL 可推广为 N 轮，N 为偶数），其后推荐的 N 是 2 的幂，但本留存件把指数排在基线位置，故不引用；第 1521 行说 「Extending FEAL-N to use a 128-bit key results in FEAL-NX」（把 FEAL-N 扩展为使用 128 位密钥即得 FEAL-NX），该注余下的模 3 密钥条件里的不等号在抽取时丢失，也只作转述。第 1522 行的例 7.99 用打印出来的向量钉住行为：「For hex plaintext M = 00000000 00000000 and hex key K = 01234567 89ABCDEF」（十六进制明文 M = 00000000 00000000，十六进制密钥 K = 01234567 89ABCDEF），其后给出 「Algorithm 7.94 generates FEAL-8 ciphertext C = CEEF2C86 F2490752.」（算法 7.94 产生 FEAL-8 密文 C = CEEF2C86 F2490752）
zh.why: 设计理由最好从 AES 候选时代继承下来的轮函数争论里看。Twofish 论文把 FEAL 放进 Feistel 设计的谱系：「It is the basis of most block ciphers published since then, including FEAL [SM88], GOST [GOST89], Khufu and Khafre [Mer91], LOKI [BPS90, BKPS93], CAST-128 [Ada97a], Blowfish [Sch94], and RC5 [Riv95].」（它是此后发表的大多数分组密码的基础，其中包括 FEAL、GOST、Khufu 与 Khafre、LOKI、CAST-128、Blowfish 和 RC5）（twofish-paper.txt:232），并回忆这一谱系当年争的是形状而不只是强度：「The early post-DES cipher designs would often compete on the number of rounds in the cipher.」（早期后 DES 时代的密码设计常常以轮数相互竞争），「The original FEAL paper [SM88], for example, discussed the benefits of a stronger round function」（例如最初的 FEAL 论文讨论了更强的轮函数带来的好处）（第 1226 行——印出的段落在该处结束，下一行已另起一段，所以引文只到从句为止）。之所以会选字节加法式的轮函数，正该文在表格式与代数式 S 盒之间划出的紧凑性权衡：FEAL 被点名为代数式的一类，而 「The advantage of the latter is that the S-boxes are more compact, and can be more easily implemented in applications where the ROM or RAM for large tables is not available.」（后者的优点是 S 盒更紧凑，便于在没有大容量 ROM 或 RAM 的应用里实现）（1294）。该文从 FEAL 学到的教训被写成对分析工作的设计约束：「Anecdotal evidence from algorithms like FEAL [SM88], CAST, and Blowfish indicates that complicated round functions are not always better than simple ones.」（来自 FEAL、CAST、Blowfish 一类算法的轶事证据表明，复杂的轮函数并不总是比简单的更好）（1264），而它点名的具体暴露面恰是差分文献找到的那一个：「Algebraic S-boxes can result in S-boxes that are vulnerable to differential cryptanalysis: [Mur90] against FEAL, and [Knu93a, Knu93b] against LOKI.」（代数式 S 盒可能做出易受差分分析攻击的 S 盒：对 FEAL 是 [Mur90]，对 LOKI 是 [Knu93a, Knu93b]）（1295）。该文件把一手论文引作 「Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm FEAL」（快速数据加密算法 FEAL），载于 Advances in Cryptology - EUROCRYPT '87 Proceedings, Springer-Verlag, 1988（2849）；那条目里的页码区间连接号字形已损，故不纳入引文。这一结构换来了什么，是 HAC 说的而不是这里说的：在 8 位处理器上的速度与极小的代码量、不做查表（hac-ch7-cast.txt:1383，见下文边界一节的引文）。
zh.used: 留存文本把 FEAL 的用处放在两处，且都由来源自己说出而非推测。第一处是它为之内建的环境：Biham-Shamir 专著第 6 章开篇说 「FEAL was suggested as a software-oriented cryptosystem which can be easily and efficiently implemented on microprocessors.」（FEAL 是作为面向软件的密码系统提出的，可以在微处理器上容易而高效地实现），并解释这在部件上意味着什么，「In the F function, the P permutation and the S boxes of DES are replaced by byte rotations and addition operations.」（在 F 函数里，DES 的 P 置换与 S 盒被字节循环与加法运算取代）（biham-shamir-1993.txt:5935）；该书术语表在第 10635 行得出同一结论：「FEAL: A family of DES-like cryptosystems which is designed to be easily and efficiently implementable on microprocessors.」（FEAL：一族与 DES 相似的密码系统，其设计目标是能在微处理器上容易而高效地实现） 「The F function of FEAL is based on the addition operation and byte rotation (rather than S boxes and permutations).」（FEAL 的 F 函数基于加法运算与字节循环（而不是 S 盒与置换））。第二处是设计者自己后续工作中的复用：「Another hash function is N-Hash[25] which was suggested by the designers of FEAL as a cryptographically strong hash function.」（另一个散列函数 N-Hash 由 FEAL 的设计者作为密码学强的散列函数提出）（第 262 行），该散列函数的 F 函数就建在 FEAL 的轮函数之上。本书还直接说明了这套攻击技术的来处：「Shoji Miyaguchi's FEAL cryptosystem motivated the first version of our attack」（三方 Miyaguchi 的 FEAL 密码系统促成了我们攻击的第一个版本）（第 34 行）——正因如此，本文里最先用它来试验该攻击的密码是 FEAL 而非更晚的算法。这些留存件与两份 HAC 抽取件都没有印出部署清单：没有任何产品、标准化机构或协议被指明在发售 FEAL，因此该条目不作部署史断言；HAC 关于曾作为商品提出的那一版的说法归入下节的边界讨论，因为那是留存语料关于用的最强一句。
zh.broken: 留存文本把被攻破写成一段设计史，而不是单一事件。HAC 就前两个与商业相关的成员给出结论：「The initial commercially proposed version with 4 rounds (FEAL-4), positioned as a fast alternative to DES, was found to be considerably less secure than expected (see Table 7.10).」（最初作为商品提出的 4 轮版本 FEAL-4 被定位为 DES 的快速替代者，结果发现其安全性明显低于预期（见表 7.10）），以及 「FEAL-8 was similarly found to offer less security than planned.」（FEAL-8 同样被发现提供的安全少于计划）（hac-ch7-cast.txt:1383）；两句的所指都是轮数，同一行还补上修补它的代价：「FEAL-16 or FEAL-32 may yet offer security comparable to DES, but throughput decreases as the number of rounds rises.」（FEAL-16 或 FEAL-32 或许仍能给出可与 DES 相比的安全，但吞吐量随轮数增加而下降）。这两句所指的表在第 1523 行引出：「Table 7.10 gives various published attacks on FEAL; LC and DC denote linear and differential cryptanalysis, and times are on common personal computers or workstations.」（表 7.10 给出已发表的对 FEAL 的各项攻击；LC 与 DC 分别指线性密码分析与差分密码分析，时间是在普通个人计算机或工作站上测得的）——表体本身（1526-1555）的行分隔符与复杂度指数都被抽取损坏，因此这里不引用其中任何数字，只引用描述它的句子。本章注释承载了弱点的机制与遗留的问题：让密码变快的线性正是让它可分析的东西，因为轮函数唯一的非线性部件是模 256 加法（1502），而注释对这一权衡自己的总结是 「While it appears to remain relatively secure when iterated a sufficient number of rounds (e.g., 24 or more), this defeats its original objective of speed.」（当迭代足够多的轮数（例如 24 轮以上）时它似乎仍相对安全，但这就违背了它最初追求速度的目标）（2195）。对仍然存世的成员，留存文本报的是比较而非证明：「Ohta and Aoki [943] suggest that FEAL-32 is as secure as DES against DC, while FEAL-16 is as secure as DES against certain restricted forms of LC.」（Ohta 与 Aoki 认为 FEAL-32 在 DC 下与 DES 一样安全，而 FEAL-16 在 certain restricted forms of LC 的某些受限形式下与 DES 一样安全）（2203）。这三份来源点名的攻击都是选择明文与已知明文攻击——该密码被列为差分分析适用的密码之一，攻击清单在表 7.10——因此边界的诚实说法是：轮数才是推动安全性的那个变量，而它的代价正是这一设计原本想避开的东西。
zh.history: 有年代的顺序就印在本章注释的一段里，该条目保留它的次序与措辞。「FEAL stimulated the development of a sequence of advanced cryptanalytic techniques of unparalleled richness and utility.」（FEAL 刺激出一系列高级密码分析技术的发展，其丰富与有用前所未见）。第一条年代证据是 「FEAL-4 as presented at Eurocrypt'87 (Abstracts of Eurocrypt'87, April 1987) was found to have certain vulnerabilities by den Boer (unpublished Eurocrypt'87 rump session talk), resulting in Shimizu and Miyaguchi [1126] (or see Miyaguchi, Shiraishi, and Shimizu [887]) increasing FEAL to 8 rounds in the final proceedings.」（在 Eurocrypt'87 上提出的 FEAL-4（Eurocrypt'87 摘要集，1987 年 4 月）被 den Boer 发现存在某些脆弱点（Eurocrypt'87 私下报告会的未发表报告），致使 Shimizu 与 Miyaguchi（或见 Miyaguchi、Shiraishi 与 Shimizu）在正式会议论文中把 FEAL 增到 8 轮）（hac-ch7-cast.txt:2195）——1987 年 4 月的摘要、一次未发表的私下报告会发现、正式论文里的 8 轮。下一条是 「In 1988 den Boer [322] showed FEAL-4 vulnerable to an adaptive chosen plaintext attack with 100 to 10 000 plaintexts.」（1988 年 den Boer 证明 FEAL-4 易受 100 到 10000 条明文的自适应选择明文攻击）。注释中被算作差分分析另一个早期变体的攻击，是 1990 年对 FEAL-8 的选择明文攻击，其决定性选择是 「the bitwise XOR of each pair being selected to be an appropriate constant (thus another early variant of differential cryptanalysis).」（每对明文的按位异或都被取为一个适当的常数（因此是差分分析的另一个早期变体））（2195）；该处两位作者在本留存件里印作 Gilbert and Chasse 后面再跟一个多余的重音字符，故名字按自己的写法写出、只按行号引用。族论文紧随其后：「FEAL-N with N rounds, and its extension FEAL-NX with 128-bit key (Notes 7.97 and 7.98) were then published by Miyaguchi [884] (or see Miyaguchi et al.[885]), who nonetheless opined that chosen-plaintext attacks on FEAL-8 were not practical threats.」（带 N 轮的 FEAL-N 与带 128 位密钥的扩展 FEAL-NX（注 7.97 与 7.98）随后由 Miyaguchi 发表（或见 Miyaguchi 等），而他们仍认为对 FEAL-8 的选择明文攻击并非实际威胁）（2196）；此后反击密集出现——「Employing den Boer's G function expressing linearity in the FEAL f -function, Murphy [913] defeated FEAL-4 with 20 chosen plaintexts in under 4 hours (under 1 hour for most keys) on a Sun 3/60 workstation.」（借助 den Boer 表达 FEAL f 函数线性性的 G 函数，Murphy 用 20 条选择明文在不到 4 小时内（多数密钥不到 1 小时）攻破了 FEAL-4，用的是一台 Sun 3/60 工作站）（2196）；同段还把 Tardy-Corfdir 与 Gilbert 的统计方法记为对 FEAL-4 与 FEAL-6 的已知明文攻击，依靠 S 盒的线性近似（2196 至 2203）；而 「the first version of linear cryptanalysis (LC) introduced by Matsui and Yamagishi [798] allowed known-plaintext attack of FEAL-4」（Matsui 与 Yamagishi 引入的线性密码分析第一个版本允许对 FEAL-4 做已知明文攻击）（2196），文中给这一版本的数字是 5 条明文与 6 分钟。较长的成员方面，注释记下 「Aoki and Ohta [53] refined these ideas for FEAL-8 yielding a differential-linear attack requiring only 12 chosen texts and 35 days of computer time (cf.Table 7.10).」（Aoki 与 Ohta 把这些想法用于 FEAL-8，得到只需 12 条选择明文与 35 天机时的差分—线性攻击）（2204）以及 「Test vectors for FEAL-N and FEAL-NX (Example 7.99) are given by Miyaguchi [884].」（FEAL-N 与 FEAL-NX 的测试向量由 Miyaguchi 给出（例 7.99））（2205）。来源本身的定年也值得记录：第 1 行印着 「This is a Chapter from the Handbook of Applied Cryptography, by A.Menezes, P.van Oorschot, and S.Vanstone, CRC Press, 1996.」（本件取自应用密码学手册第 7 章，作者 A.Menezes、P.van Oorschot、S.Vanstone，CRC Press，1996 年），而第 6 行与第 2197 行反复出现的页脚把版权符号排成裸字母 c、年份写作 1997；两处都按行号引用，不合并成一个年份。

en.principle: **Algorithm**: Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm (FEAL 分组密码). HAC 7.5 opens by naming the object and saying what it is known for: "The Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm (FEAL) is a family of algorithms which has played a critical role in the development and refinement of various advanced cryptanalytic techniques, including linear and differential cryptanalysis." The parameters follow on the same line: "FEAL-N maps 64-bit plaintext to 64-bit ciphertext blocks under a 64-bit secret key." and the shape is given as "It is an N -round Feistel cipher similar to DES (cf. Equations (7.4), (7.5)), but with a far simpler f -function, and augmented by initial and final stages which XOR the two data halves as well as XOR subkeys directly onto the data halves." - the odd spacing of N -round and f -function is how this extraction prints the italicised symbols, and it is kept. The 8-round member is the one the chapter spells out ("Algorithm 7.94 specifies FEAL-8." at hac-ch7-cast.txt:1384), and the round function is described in its own terms at 1384: two byte-oriented S-boxes S0 and S1, each used twice. The arithmetic that matters is stated at hac-ch7-cast.txt:1502: "As the operations of 2-bit rotation and XOR are both linear, the only nonlinear elementary operation in FEAL is addition mod 256." so the only source of nonlinearity is mod-256 addition, the rotation and the XOR being linear; the input width of the f-function is given there as a product of 32 and 16 bits, whose multiplication sign this extraction prints as a degraded glyph, so it is paraphrased rather than quoted. Decryption needs no second algorithm: "Decryption may be achieved using Algorithm 7.94 with the same key K and ciphertext C = (R8, L8) as the plaintext input M , but with the key schedule reversed." and "This is directly analogous to decryption for DES (Note 7.84)." (hac-ch7-cast.txt:1513). The family notation is defined in the same section - "FEAL with 64-bit key can be generalized to N -rounds, N even." at 1520, with the recommended N stated as a power of two whose exponent sits at baseline in the retained text, so it is not quoted; and "Extending FEAL-N to use a 128-bit key results in FEAL-NX" at 1521, the remainder of that note being the modulo-3 key conditions whose inequality signs do not survive extraction. Example 7.99 at 1522 fixes the behaviour with printed vectors: "For hex plaintext M = 00000000 00000000 and hex key K = 01234567 89ABCDEF" (with key bytes continuing to 89ABCDEF) and "Algorithm 7.94 generates FEAL-8 ciphertext C = CEEF2C86 F2490752."
en.why: The design rationale is best seen in the round-function debate the AES-era submissions inherited. Twofish's paper places FEAL in the lineage of Feistel designs: "It is the basis of most block ciphers published since then, including FEAL [SM88], GOST [GOST89], Khufu and Khafre [Mer91], LOKI [BPS90, BKPS93], CAST-128 [Ada97a], Blowfish [Sch94], and RC5 [Riv95]." (twofish-paper.txt:232), and it recalls how that lineage argued about shape rather than only about strength: "The early post-DES cipher designs would often compete on the number of rounds in the cipher." "The original FEAL paper [SM88], for example, discussed the benefits of a stronger round function" (1226 - the printed paragraph ends there and the next line begins a new paragraph, so the mark stops inside the clause). The reason a byte-addition round function was chosen at all is the compactness trade the same paper draws between table-driven and algebraic S-boxes: FEAL is named among the algebraic ones, and "The advantage of the latter is that the S-boxes are more compact, and can be more easily implemented in applications where the ROM or RAM for large tables is not available." (1294). The lesson Twofish draws from FEAL is stated as a design constraint on analysis: "Anecdotal evidence from algorithms like FEAL [SM88], CAST, and Blowfish indicates that complicated round functions are not always better than simple ones." (1264), and the specific exposure it names is exactly the one the differential literature found: "Algebraic S-boxes can result in S-boxes that are vulnerable to differential cryptanalysis: [Mur90] against FEAL, and [Knu93a, Knu93b] against LOKI." (1295). The primary paper is cited by this file as "Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm FEAL" in Advances in Cryptology - EUROCRYPT '87 Proceedings, Springer-Verlag, 1988 (2849); the page-range dash in that entry is degraded, so the range is left out of the mark. What the structure bought is stated by HAC, not here: speed and small code on 8-bit processors, with no table look-ups (hac-ch7-cast.txt:1383, quoted under the limits section below).
en.used: The retained texts put FEAL's use in two places, both stated by the sources rather than assumed. The first is the environment it was built for: Chapter 6 of the Biham-Shamir book opens "FEAL was suggested as a software-oriented cryptosystem which can be easily and efficiently implemented on microprocessors." and explains what that meant for the parts, "In the F function, the P permutation and the S boxes of DES are replaced by byte rotations and addition operations." (biham-shamir-1993.txt:5935) - the same conclusion the book's own glossary reaches at 10635: "FEAL: A family of DES-like cryptosystems which is designed to be easily and efficiently implementable on microprocessors." "The F function of FEAL is based on the addition operation and byte rotation (rather than S boxes and permutations)." The second is reuse inside the designers' own later work: "Another hash function is N-Hash[25] which was suggested by the designers of FEAL as a cryptographically strong hash function." (262), the hashing function carrying an F function built on the FEAL round function. The book also says plainly where the attack technique came from: "Shoji Miyaguchi's FEAL cryptosystem motivated the first version of our attack" (34), which is why FEAL, not some later cipher, is the cipher the technique was first worked out against in this text. Neither this file nor the two HAC extractions registered here print a deployment inventory - no product, standardisation body or protocol is named as shipping FEAL - so this entry claims no deployment history; HAC's separate sentence about a commercially proposed version is treated under the limits section, because that is the strongest statement the retained corpus makes about use.
en.broken: The breakage is recorded as design history rather than as a single event. HAC states the outcome for the first two commercially relevant members: "The initial commercially proposed version with 4 rounds (FEAL-4), positioned as a fast alternative to DES, was found to be considerably less secure than expected (see Table 7.10)." and "FEAL-8 was similarly found to offer less security than planned." (hac-ch7-cast.txt:1383); the referent of both sentences is the round count, and the same line adds the price of fixing it: "FEAL-16 or FEAL-32 may yet offer security comparable to DES, but throughput decreases as the number of rounds rises." The table those sentences point at is introduced at 1523: "Table 7.10 gives various published attacks on FEAL; LC and DC denote linear and differential cryptanalysis, and times are on common personal computers or workstations." - the table body itself (1526-1555) has its row separators and its exponent complexities degraded by extraction, so no figure from it is quoted here, only the sentences that describe it. The chapter's notes carry the mechanism of the weakness and the residual question: the linearity that made the cipher fast is what made it analyzable, since the round function's only nonlinear element is mod-256 addition (1502), and the notes' own summary of the trade-off is "While it appears to remain relatively secure when iterated a sufficient number of rounds (e.g., 24 or more), this defeats its original objective of speed." (2195). For the surviving members the retained text reports comparison, not proof: "Ohta and Aoki [943] suggest that FEAL-32 is as secure as DES against DC, while FEAL-16 is as secure as DES against certain restricted forms of LC." (2203). The attacks named in these three sources are chosen-plaintext and known-plaintext attacks - the cipher is listed among the ciphers differential cryptanalysis applies to, and the catalogue of attacks is in Table 7.10 - so the honest statement of the boundary is that round count was the variable that moved security, at a cost the design was meant to avoid.
en.history: The dated sequence is printed in one paragraph of the chapter notes, and this entry keeps its order and its wording. "FEAL stimulated the development of a sequence of advanced cryptanalytic techniques of unparalleled richness and utility." The first datum is "FEAL-4 as presented at Eurocrypt'87 (Abstracts of Eurocrypt'87, April 1987) was found to have certain vulnerabilities by den Boer (unpublished Eurocrypt'87 rump session talk), resulting in Shimizu and Miyaguchi [1126] (or see Miyaguchi, Shiraishi, and Shimizu [887]) increasing FEAL to 8 rounds in the final proceedings." (hac-ch7-cast.txt:2195) - an April 1987 abstract, an unpublished rump-session finding, and eight rounds in the final proceedings. The next is "In 1988 den Boer [322] showed FEAL-4 vulnerable to an adaptive chosen plaintext attack with 100 to 10 000 plaintexts." The attack that the notes describe as another early variant of differential cryptanalysis is the 1990 chosen-plaintext attack on FEAL-8, whose defining choice is "the bitwise XOR of each pair being selected to be an appropriate constant (thus another early variant of differential cryptanalysis)." (2195); the two designers are named in the retained text as Gilbert and Chasse followed by a stray accent glyph, so the name is written in own words and cited by line instead of quoted. The family papers follow: "FEAL-N with N rounds, and its extension FEAL-NX with 128-bit key (Notes 7.97 and 7.98) were then published by Miyaguchi [884] (or see Miyaguchi et al. [885]), who nonetheless opined that chosen-plaintext attacks on FEAL-8 were not practical threats." (2196), and the counter-attacks then come thick - "Employing den Boer's G function expressing linearity in the FEAL f -function, Murphy [913] defeated FEAL-4 with 20 chosen plaintexts in under 4 hours (under 1 hour for most keys) on a Sun 3/60 workstation." (2196); a statistical method of Tardy-Corfdir and Gilbert is credited at 2196-2203 with a known-plaintext attack on FEAL-4 and FEAL-6 using linear approximation of the S-boxes; and "the first version of linear cryptanalysis (LC) introduced by Matsui and Yamagishi [798] allowed known-plaintext attack of FEAL-4" (2196), the text giving five texts and six minutes for that first version of linear cryptanalysis. For the longer members the notes report "Aoki and Ohta [53] refined these ideas for FEAL-8 yielding a differential-linear attack requiring only 12 chosen texts and 35 days of computer time (cf. Table 7.10)." (2204) and "Test vectors for FEAL-N and FEAL-NX (Example 7.99) are given by Miyaguchi [884]." (2205). The dating of the source itself is also worth recording: line 1 prints "This is a Chapter from the Handbook of Applied Cryptography, by A. Menezes, P. van Oorschot, and S. Vanstone, CRC Press, 1996." while the recurring footer at line 6 and 2197 prints the copyright line with the sign degraded to a bare c and the year 1997; both are cited by line rather than merged into one date.

zh: FEAL 分组密码（Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm）：一族与 DES 相似的 N 轮 Feistel 密码，64 位分组、64 位密钥，hac-ch7-cast.txt:1382。
FEAL-N 与 FEAL-NX：把轮数推广为偶数 N 的成员，以及把密钥扩到 128 位、随之改动密钥处理的成员（hac-ch7-cast.txt:1520-1521）。
f 函数：FEAL 的轮函数，用两个字节导向 S 盒各两次；留存件称其唯一的非线性运算为模 256 加法（hac-ch7-cast.txt:1384、1502）。
首末变换：Feistel 循环之外附加的两级，既把两个数据半区互相异或，也把子密钥直接异或到半区上（hac-ch7-cast.txt:1382）。
反序密钥编排：FEAL 的解密方式——同一算法、密文充当明文输入、密钥编排逆序（hac-ch7-cast.txt:1513）。
实际子密钥：Biham-Shamir 术语，指差分攻击求出的量；因攻击绕过密钥处理算法，FEAL-N 与 FEAL-NX 代价相同（biham-shamir-1993.txt:6695）。
en: FEAL (Fast Data Encipherment Algorithm): a family of N -round Feistel ciphers DES-like in shape, with 64-bit blocks under a 64-bit key (hac-ch7-cast.txt:1382).
FEAL-N and FEAL-NX: the member generalised to even N rounds, and the member with a 128-bit key and an altered key schedule (hac-ch7-cast.txt:1520-1521).
f-function: the FEAL round function, using two byte-oriented S-boxes twice each; mod-256 addition is the only nonlinear elementary operation the retained text names (hac-ch7-cast.txt:1384, 1502).
initial and final transformations: the extra stages that XOR the data halves with each other and XOR subkeys straight onto them (hac-ch7-cast.txt:1382).
reversed key schedule: how FEAL decrypts - Algorithm 7.94 again, ciphertext fed in as the plaintext, subkeys used backwards (hac-ch7-cast.txt:1513).
actual subkeys: the Biham-Shamir term for what the differential attack recovers; because the key processing algorithm is bypassed, FEAL-N and FEAL-NX cost the same (biham-shamir-1993.txt:6695).
